decisions.assessment: The new summary preserves the around-two washing and drying setups, limited detergent, cloth-folding sequence, carrying help and supervised partial participation.
Both contexts preserve the chart’s eighteen-month-to-three span separately from the around-two appendix setup, its cup of water and optional vinegar, with shared work and manageable materials.
The summary retains the around-two two-tub washing setup, scrub board and soap, supervision and permission to repeat only one movement.
The summary distinguishes appendix baking with help from two and a half and the home chart’s three-to-four measuring and mixing, retaining supervised partial preparation.
Both contexts retain the eighteen-to-twenty-two-plus table-washing materials, limited setup, adult help and a partial scrubbing contribution.
Both contexts retain the book’s nontoxic condition for mirror and wood products and keep the later two-and-a-half shoe-polishing materials separate under supervision.
All three contexts preserve the toddler-wide distinction between stored rotation and passing an outgrown item on, with a final turn and supported participation rather than a required child skill.
